name: Candlestick chart
purpose: Open-high-low-close (OHLC) per period, one candle per session — a real SVG candlestick chart. NET-NEW, chart-expansion programme WAVE 2 lane ② (statistical/gauge), 2026-08-05. Built to the Chart-scatter Layer-1 pattern (toolbar + table spine); PROVISIONAL-AGENT pending Dave's eyeball and conductor registration.

props.name: up
props.$note: close ≥ open — body fill = data/delta/gain (RULED, brief §C·1(a)).

props.name: down
props.$note: close < open — body fill = data/delta/loss (RULED, brief §C·1(a)).

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> mirroring OHLC columns per session (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: ten sessions
variants.use: A short price series — wick per session (ink @ reduced weight), body coloured by direction.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — axis ticks/labels .t-cm-chart-label/-value · table .t-cm-legal
tokens.delta: data/delta/gain (body up) / data/delta/loss (body down) — RULED binding (brief §C·1(a)), consumed VERBATIM from canon.css (--data-delta-gain #16864E/#1AA05C, --data-delta-loss #B92F1E/#CC4333 light/dark), not re-derived. Owned by the RAG/delta colour workstream.
tokens.wick: ink (text/default) at .6 alpha, 1px — brief-ruled: 'wicks = ink at reduced weight'
tokens.axis: ⛔ ds-020 RECEIPTED GAP — pre-DV-D07 ink-at-alpha idiom, not the minted two-channel roles. Copied the mark contract + toolbar per the DIVVY brief, deliberately NOT the axis/grid CSS.
tokens.$survey: Net-new for wave 2. Grounds its vocabulary in Chart-bar (toolbar, frame, grid convention pre-DV-D07) and the data/delta/* tokens minted for the RAG/delta workstream.

motion.entry: Each candle fades in on a stagger — CSS-only (DEF-003).
motion.reducedMotion: Fade sits inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale — text must not scale. Static answer: fixed 580×260 + horizontal scroll. FIT hooks NOT wired — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers present but empty (conductor serial); see receipt.

mustNotNeighbour: A second chart re-using data/delta/gain·loss for a DIFFERENT semantic (e.g. status ramp) in the same journey (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a data-summary aria-label describing the series' range, open and close.
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; each candle body carries data-tip/aria-label with full OHLC; the real table is the full data surface.
accessibility.keyboard: Candle bodies are tabindex 0 with aria-label (value popover behaviour NOT yet wired — see AUTO-BEHAVIOUR gap).
accessibility.nonText: Gain/loss fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 — DECLARED, not yet render-verified, see receipt). #96-D1 ①: shape/fill is now a SECOND non-colour channel — up bodies are hollow (page fill, gain-token stroke), down bodies are filled (loss-token fill+stroke), standard candlestick convention, same tokens.

antiPatterns: Raw hex fills for gain/loss (dv-017 — must ride data/delta/gain·loss)
Re-deriving gain/loss instead of consuming the canon.css tokens (creates a second source of truth)
Scaling the SVG proportionally at narrow widths (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)

tokenValidation.result: DECLARED, NOT YET RENDER-VERIFIED — mechanical var()-only fill audit clean; DataViz gate run OWED (conductor serial, see receipt).
tokenValidation.$note: NET-NEW, wave 2 lane ②, worker Sonnet. PROVISIONAL-AGENT — not registered as a dataviz $member yet (conductor serial).
